info.name: Grading Partner API — spec for Mariam Gabalawy
info.description:
The API your platform must EXPOSE so that Sahahly can pull submissions and post marks back.

This is the partner-side contract. All three endpoints are authenticated with a static `x-api-key` header holding the API key YOU generate and send to Sahahly.

Separately, your platform must CALL our webhook when a student submits. That direction is documented in `webhook-spec.md` — read both.

Set the `BASE_URL` collection variable to your origin only (e.g. `https://portal.example.com`), with no `/api/grading` suffix. Sahahly's client appends `/api/grading` itself.

Field names, types and the response envelope below are read directly by Sahahly's client and must match exactly.

variable.description: Your origin. No trailing slash, no /api/grading suffix.
The key you generate and send to Sahahly. Sahahly sends it back as x-api-key on every request below.
Sample submission id used by the requests.

request.description:
The COMPLETE list of submissions, newest first. NOT paginated.

Return every submission you hold that matches the `filter[...]` params (or every submission you hold at all, if no filter is sent). Do not cap the result and do not split it across pages.

Sahahly's client may still send `page` / `per_page` on some calls. IGNORE them: return the full list regardless. They are leftovers from the previous paginated contract and carry no meaning — never treat them as a request for a subset.

The response is a single JSON object with one required key, `data`, holding the array:
`{ "data": [ …submission objects… ] }`
Sahahly reads `data[]` and nothing else. Extra top-level keys are ignored, so you may include a `total` if it is convenient, but it is not required and is not read.

Each element of `data[]` is a submission object (see the example). `mark_scheme` MAY be null here for submissions that have no mark scheme yet — but see webhook-spec.md, where it may NOT be null.

IMPORTANT — this endpoint must mint FRESH pre-signed file URLs on every call, exactly like `GET /submissions/{id}`. Every `mark_scheme` and `attachments[]` URL in the response must be valid and directly downloadable at the moment you reply. Sahahly may download from this response without re-fetching, so cached or already-expired URLs here will break grading.

As the collection grows, use the `filter[...]` params to bound what you return rather than introducing pagination. If the unbounded response ever gets large enough to be a problem, tell us before changing the shape.

response.name: 200 — Index Submissions

request.description:
A single submission object (NOT wrapped in a pagination envelope, NOT wrapped in `data`).

IMPORTANT — this endpoint must mint FRESH pre-signed file URLs on every call. Sahahly calls it specifically to recover from expired URLs before downloading PDFs. Returning cached/expired URLs here will break grading.

Must return 404 if the submission does not exist. Sahahly treats 404 as 'fall back to the payload you sent us on the webhook', so a 404 is safe but a 500 is not.

request.description:
Sahahly calls this once a submission has been marked.

Request body:
- `grade`   — number, always sent.
- `comments` — string, omitted entirely when empty (do not assume the key is present).
- `attachments` — array of URLs to the marked/annotated PDF. Omitted entirely when empty.

CRITICAL — the URL in `attachments` is a Cloudflare R2 pre-signed URL that EXPIRES AFTER 7 DAYS. You must download the file and store your own copy when you receive this request. Do not hotlink it or persist it as-is; it will 403 after a week.

On success, mark the submission as graded so that subsequent `marked: true` / `status: "Marked"` / `grade` values are reflected in the two GET endpoints.

Respond 201 with the envelope in the example. Sahahly returns your response body to its dashboard verbatim but does not parse individual fields, so the `data` shape is advisory — the status code is what matters.

response.name: 201 — Mark created
